verdict.rationale: Figma Make is a hosted AI app-building product that could plausibly offer event webhooks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Make events. MCP connections to external tools and generated backends are adjacent features, not webhook subscriptions, and a community report says the API returns 400 for .make files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
